patterns: APPSC asks direct 'aimed at / associated with' items: Inclusive India initiative, EKAM Fest, PRASHAST app, Sugamya Bharat Abhiyan, RCI Act 1992.
Scheme-to-purpose matching is the core shape; distractors come from other welfare groups (women, PVTGs, transgender persons).
Recurring numbers: 21 disabilities, 40% benchmark, 4% jobs vs 5% higher education, 3 December, in force 19 April 2017.
App adds many case-law and 2026 current items (SC rulings, AP Divyang Shakti) and spending ratios beyond what PYQs show.
